title: Webhook listener e2e suite
description: Blocked by TODO(pi-caretaker-1): authenticated listener, validation and queue admission. handlePostEvents and extension.activate both throw not implemented, so there is no server to boot. tests/e2e/webhook.e2e.test.ts holds 9 it.todo cases over a real socket: health shape, 401, 413 at the 64 KiB cap, 400 for bad JSON and unknown severity, real overload status instead of a fake 202, 405/404, plus the invariant that no malformed request ever gets 202. Write them as real tests in that change and delete tests/scaffold.test.ts, whose stub assertions go red on purpose when the stub lands.
author: Tomislav Zorcec
